notes.title: TrainerVR 2.0 Ready!! Drive your train inside it!
notes.content:
Do you want to see your creations from the driver point of view? Drive safe or you will derail!

Thank you to all players for supporting this beautiful game. Lots of work has done on this new release, we had to rewrite the game core to support the new and expected feature: Driving trains.

Features:
[list]
[*] Teleport into the trains and see the world from the driver point of view
[*] Use hands to drive the train
[*] Drive the trains, accelerate, brake, use the whistle...
[*] Use the frontal lever to change train path on bifurcations, just put the lever on the desired position before arriving the bifurcation
[*] Accelerate to the max speed and brake on curves or the train will derail!
[*] Acceleration and deceleration are affected by charge. The more wagons, the more difficult will be driving the train
[*] Teleport outside the train to back to normal view
[*] Comfort settings to avoid sickness are configurable on the settings menu
[/list]

The experience is very nice, I recommend to you to live it!

Come on board!

notes.title: v1.9: 3D Rudder support + demolition ball
notes.content:
Good news! We have realeased today a new version with 2 cool improvements:

[h1]Support to 3D Rudder[/h1]
A foot motion controller to move into the virtual world, even up and down!

[h1]Demolition ball[/h1]
Very funny addition, find it under the TNT and use it to destroy with your hands your creations.

We are still working on riding and driving the trains. It will be ready very soon!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.7 released: The "Red Button" update
notes.content:
We've been working hard making some serious performance boost. Everything is now sorted out and now we can resume adding some new cool stuff and awesome features.

Apart from the performance we've added some other enjoyable things:

[list]
    [*]Track button: link its action to other piece action, press the button, and let the magic begin.
    [*]Train crash: TrainerVR is now face to face train crash frustation-free.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Trainer v1.5 Major update
notes.content:
Version 1.5 is here! This update includes lots of new fun features and a new build-from-the-ground train physics (no more frustrating no-crash situations, lol)

Version new features:
- Remodeled Train Physics (Frustration-Free)
- TNT (hours of fun guaranteed)
- New Menu categories
- Lots of new stuff: downtown modular buildings, track pieces, huge mountains, animals.
- New controller models (wrecking ball enabled!)
- Arc teleport
- Character animations
- Performance improvements
- And probably more things we don't remember right now

notes.title: TrainerVR v1.4 released. Support to Windows Mixed Reality Ready!
notes.content:

notes.title: New version TrainerVR 1.3 Released!
notes.content:
This version is awesome, check the new features:

- New snap system. Tracks will never move again and you will be able to create distant towns and join them. The new snap system works great!
- Thumbsitck control movement for HTC.
- Added another decoration menu full of new and cool items
- Added cargo items to load on trains
- Added cointainers 
- Added safe construction mode

Enjoy!
